scripts.install:local: npm run build && npm run build:firefox && npm run zip:firefox && mkdir -p ~/.local/share/browser-extensions/page2md && rm -rf ~/.local/share/browser-extensions/page2md/chrome ~/.local/share/browser-extensions/page2md/firefox && cp -r .output/chrome-mv3 ~/.local/share/browser-extensions/page2md/chrome && cp -r .output/firefox-mv2 ~/.local/share/browser-extensions/page2md/firefox && cp .output/page2md-${npm_package_version}-firefox.zip ~/.local/share/browser-extensions/page2md/page2md.xpi
scripts.sign:firefox: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; set -a; source .env; set +a; npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext sign --channel=unlisted --source-dir=.output/firefox-mv2 --artifacts-dir="$HOME/.local/share/browser-extensions/page2md" --api-key="$AMO_JWT_ISSUER" --api-secret="$AMO_JWT_SECRET"'
